evidence_requirements.title: Operational Evidence Binding Requirement
evidence_requirements.binds_environment: Evidence binds to the specific environment in which it was produced.

evidence_requirements.binds_version: Evidence binds to the exact software and policy version.
evidence_requirements.binds_identity: Evidence binds to the acting identity.
evidence_requirements.binds_org: Evidence binds to the organization context.
evidence_requirements.binds_jurisdiction: Evidence binds to the applicable jurisdiction.
evidence_requirements.binds_data_classification: Evidence binds to the data classification of the subject data.

evidence_requirements.binds_time: Evidence binds to the time of production.
